ja: 月刊コミックボンボンでマンガ好評連載中の「SDガンダムフォース絵巻」の主役である「少年武者烈丸」のプラモデル。低年齢でも組み立てやすい少ない部品数で構成しています。首、腕、足が可動します。武器は大型刀、小型刀が付属します。
en: A plastic model of ``Shoumusha Retsumaru'', the main character of ``SD Gundam Force Emaki'', which is currently being serialized in Comic Bonbon. It is composed of a small number of parts that is easy to assemble even at a young age. The neck, arms, and legs are movable. Weapons include a large sword and a small sword.
